name: zrndr_lens_flare_set_visible_sample_stage
description: zRndr_LensFlare_SetVisibleSampleStage stores one visible lens-flare texture stage when the index is in range and enables visible-sample drawing only when all four stages are present.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this lens-flare helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zRndr lens-flare/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x49aa40 validates the in-range stage-index store, ignored out-of-range indices, and visibility-active flag set only when all four stage pointers are non-null.
The native smoke verifies reset behavior shared by the stage helper group, ignored negative and index-4 stores, activation after all four stages are present, and deactivation when a stage is cleared.
